metadata.description: Live-captured via tools/internalapps-capture --use-begininstall (ChunkedUploader.BeginInstall, legacy InternalAppChunkTransactionV1 DTO) against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Workstream C. Uploaded a real, valid HelloMDMTest.ipa (unexpired embedded.mobileprovision, Info.plist DTPlatformName=iphoneos present -- omitting DTPlatformName triggers a live server NRE surfaced as an opaque HTTP 500; the same NRE was reproduced live before switching to the DTPlatformName-bearing vendored .ipa). device_type=Apple, model_name=iPhone (live-confirmed valid picklist value via GET /api/mdm/picklists/platforms/APPLE/devicemodels: Any|iPad|iPhone|iPod Touch -- an earlier-documented claimed 'model_name Apple' default is NOT valid on this tenant, rejected with 400 'Device Model specified is invalid.'). 200, real app created (teardown-deleted immediately after capture; DELETE + post-delete GET both confirmed no orphan). Anonymized: BundleId, LocationGroupId, Id.Value, ApplicationName. DISCLOSURE: the body's OrganizationGroupUuid and Uuid fields (underscore-quoted here as "aaaaaaaa_1111_2222_3333_444444444444" and "bbbbbbbb_2222_3333_4444_555555555555" to avoid the public sync scrubber's dash-form-UUID rewrite; the field values on the wire use dashes, not underscores) are NOT anonymizer output -- both are hand-typed, repeated-hex-word placeholder values, not genuine server-issued or anonymizer-fingerprinted UUIDs. The rest of the body (real ids, real device/app metadata) is genuinely live-captured per the citation above.
